prior_review_finding_dispositions.evidence: The CLI now exposes authority, record-authority-validation, prepare-closeout, and terminal-seal. The authority entry consumes D1/D5-D16, prepare-closeout consumes D1/D11/D13/D15 and produces the final manifest and eligibility/request artifacts, and terminal-seal validates a distinct independent review plus owner seal before producing branch disposition, sealed-successor closeout, and terminal hash seal.

All four D16 target files are absent before authorization, their candidate files and hashes are sealed under attempt-0020, and an explicit post-D16 adoption producer exists. The exact affected-symbol boundary is still not enforced; see IMPORTANT-001.

The adopted consumer now opens the selected inputs and the authority path compares expected and actual proposition inventories byte-for-byte, target set, required axes, duplicates, schema/license validity, invented/dropped propositions, and actual inventory profile count. The separate required same-skeleton/threshold authority validation is still absent; see IMPORTANT-002.

Curated reviewed sources now carry a declared source class and D5 is passed into validation. Declared Layer 4 sources are rejected under deny and accepted only under allow with review_role=human_review_context_only; both branches have detector fixtures.

findings.title: D16 authorizes a narrower symbol set than the candidate files actually create
findings.evidence: The runner manifest lists only build_food_semantic_proposition_inventory, consume_food_semantic_inputs_no_render, and build_food_semantic_no_render_receipt as affected/owner-allowed symbols. The sealed replacement also creates four additional top-level functions: _sha256_file, _load_jsonl, _canonical_jsonl_bytes, and _member_set_sha256. Candidate generation merely checks that listed symbol names occur as substrings, hard-codes candidate_patch_out_of_scope_symbol_count=0, and adoption verifies only whole-file hashes and paths; neither path enumerates or rejects unlisted symbols. Owner-input validation then requires allowed_symbols to equal the incomplete manifest list.
findings.impact: D16 can approve and install code outside the exact affected-symbol authorization boundary, contrary to the plan's requirement to reject any manifest-outside symbol after D16.
findings.required_action: Derive each candidate's complete top-level symbol set structurally, include every created symbol in the affected/allowed set or inline the helpers into authorized symbols, and make both candidate sealing and post-D16 adoption fail when the replacement defines any symbol outside the exact authorized manifest.

findings.title: Authority execution still omits the required same-skeleton and canonical threshold validation
findings.evidence: The actual consumer now projects exact propositions and counts unique semantic profiles, but it never computes Naturalization skeleton groups or a maximum same-skeleton group. Authority execution emits proposition reconciliation and semantic_partition_report only. The implementation artifact remains skeleton_group_report.schema.json with implementation_result_emitted=false, while threshold_authority_binding.json remains unevaluated with detector/policy identities null and authority_match_evaluated=false. No post-D16 producer classifies policy_lag/detector_lag/genuine_fork, seals a canonical threshold identity/value, or evaluates maximum_same_skeleton_group <= bound_threshold_value, yet prepare-closeout does not require those predicates.
findings.impact: Change 12 and terminal closeout can PASS without O-12, threshold_source_identity_bound, threshold_policy_detector_identity_match, or the plan-required same-skeleton acceptance bound.
findings.required_action: Run the adopted actual Phase 2 skeleton grouping path, bind the canonical policy and detector identities/value, classify and block unresolved identity lag, emit skeleton_group_report.json, and require the maximum same-skeleton predicate before post-authority validation or terminal closeout can PASS.

findings.title: The reviewed implementation can drift before authority execution without being detected or terminally bound
findings.evidence: A verify command exists and checks the implementation bundle's referenced artifact files, but the authority command does not call it. validate_authority_execution_inputs checks the bundle file identity and sealed flag only; it does not rehash its 190 referenced artifacts. The terminal manifest includes the attempt root, authority documents, owner inputs, claim-boundary document, and adopted D16 files, but excludes candidate_writer.py, closeout.py, the authority CLI, and the other core implementation code. Although the old implementation bundle file is included, terminal sealing verifies only top-level final-manifest rows and never expands/revalidates the nested bundle artifact identities.
findings.impact: After this external review, reviewed authority or closeout code can change, execute, and reach a terminal seal while the external-review bundle hash and terminal manifest both remain valid.
findings.required_action: Make authority entry reverify the complete sealed bundle artifact manifest and abort on drift. Include all executed implementation/closeout code directly in the final artifact manifest, or recursively revalidate the nested implementation bundle during prepare-closeout and terminal-seal.
